title: Attention in the decoder: masks and cross-attention

items.stem: A decoder's self-attention runs on 4 tokens with the standard causal mask, giving a 4 by 4 matrix of attention weights after softmax. How many of its 16 entries are nonzero? Give a number.
A transformer summarizes articles: its encoder reads the article and its decoder writes the summary. In its encoder-decoder attention, where do the keys and values come from?

options.text: Keys from the decoder, values from the encoder output
Both from the decoder's previous layer, like the queries
Both from the encoder's output, the read article
Keys from the encoder output, values from the decoder

items.stem: In a decoder's masked self-attention, consider the very first token of the sequence. After softmax, what is the weight it puts on its own value vector? Give a number.
Query and key components are independent with mean 0 and variance 1. When d_k grows from 16 to 64, what happens to the standard deviation of an unscaled query-key dot product?

A translation transformer's encoder has read an English sentence of 7 tokens, and its decoder has produced 4 French tokens so far. In the encoder-decoder attention, what is the shape of the score matrix QK^T? Answer as rows by columns.
After scaling and masking, one query's scores over three tokens are [2, 2, minus infinity]. What are its attention weights after softmax?
